0c1e924baae3ecbc5fa96e88a1afd0d7d55e8b97.summary: Aqua Team Nautilus analysed eight malicious container images in the Docker Hub account hildeteamtnt, which the report says TeamTNT used. The images carried cryptominers, Tsunami and Mirai, backdoors and Docker escape tools, and at least two were used in attacks. The report calls it a still-active campaign against cloud native environments and misconfigured Docker API ports, and says the newer images use more defence evasion. Published 2020-08-25.

0ce1eae63e681b49a35d3d50bcf5b34100b0272f.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that two North Korean nation-state actors, Diamond Sleet and Onyx Sleet, have exploited the JetBrains TeamCity remote-code execution flaw CVE-2023-42793 since early October 2023. Diamond Sleet deployed ForestTiger and DLL search-order hijacking payloads, and Onyx Sleet created a new user account and deployed the HazyLoad proxy tool. Both actors dumped credentials from LSASS memory. Microsoft assesses the actors may be opportunistically compromising vulnerable servers. JetBrains has released an update and a mitigation.
